suggestions.pitch: Hockenson (0.5 lineup value) and Henry are surplus TEs behind Ferguson; Hubbard and Slayton cost me almost nothing now and a 4-2 contender needs the depth.
Henry and aging Keenan Allen (34) are low-impact pieces, and Gainwell (13.7 a week lately) plus Hubbard are younger RB options at minimal lineup cost.
Geno Smith adds only 4 lineup points behind Jackson and Brissett, so converting him into Gainwell (13.7 a week lately) improves my RB depth.
